pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 - runtime containers crashlooping with SIGSEGV in us-west-2 (affecting model route wizard-13b-8bit). Pager sends to #incidents and oncall.

sre_oncall: I'm on it. seeing elevated crashloop counts across 3 nodes (gpu-pool-3a). Span of failures ~10m. any visible deploys?

alex_chen: no deploys from infra. I've pulled logs from one of the pods. pattern looks like fused_kernel.cpp -> trt_fused_infer -> segfault at memcpy. attaching snippet.

alex_chen: ```
[2026-03-15T02:14:03Z] runtime: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f9a1234abcd sp 0x7ffd9b12e000 error 4
#0 0x7f9a1234abcd in trt::fused::run_infer()
#1 0x7f9a2345bcde in vllm::Runtime::execute_batch()
#2 0x55aa11223344 in worker_loop
```

maria_rivera: stack looks like TensorRT fused kernel hitting a null deref. Could be a race in KV cache when batch size spikes. I see large sequence lengths in the traces.

dmitri_iv: also seeing node flaps — k8s reports container runtime restarts causing node to be NotReady briefly. Likely crashloop pressure -> kubelet pressure.

eng_runtime: confirming similar traces from our internal test harness when running wizard-13b-8bit with constant 1024 sequence and batch 8. We have an intermittent null ptr in fused_kernels after recent optimization in commit 9f3a (tensor alignment change).

sre_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) divert production traffic for wizard-13b-8bit to fallback variant wizard-13b-fp16 via smart routing, 2) cordon & drain affected nodes, 3) scale up replacement nodes. Maria/dmitri can you run the routing change?

maria_rivera: started routing override via console -> deployed policy: route wizard-13b-8bit -> wizard-13b-fp16 for 100% in us-west-2. commands: ```rbac: update routing policy id=rp-4523 set variant=wizard-13b-fp16 region=us-west-2``` should be active in ~30s.

ops_bot: Routing policy rp-4523 applied by maria_rivera at 2026-03-15T02:18:22Z. Traffic divert confirmed: 100% to wizard-13b-fp16 (us-west-2).

customer_success_bot: Notifying on-call CS: some customers reporting elevated 503s for wizard route; we've opened a ticket for affected customers and applied temporary mitigations.

sre_oncall: cordon/drain in progress. running: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-3a-07 && kubectl drain gpu-node-3a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30```

dmitri_iv: drain started. draining two more nodes: gpu-node-3a-08 gpu-node-3a-09. I've increased GPU pool autoscaler to add 4 nodes to compensate.

alex_chen: collecting core dumps from crashed pods. gcore is present. kernel core shows address in libcudart call chain. attaching sanitized gdb backtrace snippet: ```
#0 0x7f9a1234abcd in trt::fused::run_infer()
#1 0x7f9a2345bcde in vllm::Runtime::execute_batch()
#2 0x55aa11223344 in start_thread
#3 0x7f9a9abcfdef in clone
```

eng_runtime: likely introduced by alignment change — data pointer occasionally null when batching triggers prefix cache eviction. we'll revert commit 9f3a on canary image and push a hotfix build. canary rollout to start once drains finish.

sre_oncall: good. Can we also temporarily disable fused kernel usage for this model in the runtime config so we avoid further GPU faults? config path: /etc/redwood/runtime/profiles/wizard-13b-8bit.json

eng_runtime: yes. patching profile to set use_fused_kernels=false and force fp16 fallback for this route. pushing patch now.

eng_runtime: ```json
{
  "model": "wizard-13b-8bit",
  "use_fused_kernels": false,
  "quant": "ephemeral-fallback-fp16"
}
```

ops_bot: Runtime config push succeeded on 6 hosts at 2026-03-15T02:25:10Z.

sre_oncall: monitoring crashloop counts. initial drain + routing + config patch reduced new crashes to 0 within 2 minutes. request error rate for the wizard route dropped from 11.8% -> 0.4% after routing change.

customer_success_bot: CS update: notified 7 customers; 2 customers opened priority tickets. CS will send status update explaining transient degradation and mitigation.

maria_rivera: while we mitigated customer impact, we still have root cause triage. Eng_runtime will prepare a reproducer and revert commit 9f3a in mainline. Dmitri, schedule nodes for hardware validation (no faulty GPUs seen so far).

dmitri_iv: scheduled maintenance window for gpu-pool-3a on 2026-03-15T05:00Z to run burn-in tests and diagnostic logs.

eng_runtime: action list: - prepare unit/regression test for batching + kv-cache race - revert 9f3a and validate on canary - add assert/guard in fused kernel to avoid null deref - add better telemetry (batch size & kv invalidation events). assigning owners: alex_chen (revert + canary), maria_rivera (telemetry), dmitri_iv (node validation).

alex_chen: pushed hotfix image rwd-infer:canary-9f3a-revert, starting canary rollout (5% traffic) to us-west-2. logs look clean on canary pods so far.

sre_oncall: begin handoff to day oncall. summary: P1 - segfaults in fused kernel caused crashloops across 3 nodes. Immediate mitigation: traffic diverted to fp16 variant, drained nodes, disabled fused kernel for that profile, hotfix canary pushed. Customer impact: ~12% error rate peak, now reduced to <1%. Next steps: revert commit in main, add regression tests, postmortem.

sre_oncall: paging day oncall @alex_chen @maria_rivera for continuity.

alex_chen: taking handoff. I'll monitor canary until 04:30Z then prep PR for mainline revert.

maria_rivera: I'll own telemetry and CS comms. prepping short status update for customers with incident id INC-20260315-1023.

pagerbot: Incident INC-20260315-1023 created and linked to this thread. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-segfaults.

sre_oncall: thanks all. we'll follow up with a postmortem and include action owners. closing active paging. :white_check_mark:
